name: beyond_update_processor_implementation_status
description: Update coding and/or UX implementation status for a processor. Inspect transformation_check and warnings: advanced implementation/UX statuses check the processor for zero transformations; new checkpoints check changed processors in the preceding checkpoint interval. Saves remain allowed; no warnings does not prove complete lineage.

implementation_status.description: Implementation workflow status shared by entities, processors, and processor UX.

transformation_check.description: Non-blocking zero-transformation check. Inspect check_status, scope, missing_processor_count, has_more and coverage_note. UNAVAILABLE is not a clean result.

warnings.description: Advisory warnings with processor/model/layer identities and next steps. Does not prevent saving; absence is not proof of complete lineage.
